title: Among cards illustrated by artists who have worked on the 'Coldsnap' set, f
question: Among cards illustrated by artists who have worked on the 'Coldsnap' set, find those with black borders and full artwork. For these cards, calculate what percentage have a converted mana cost of exactly 4.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_011" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2."XCL_099" = T1."XCL_063"
WHERE T2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND T1."XCL_005" = 'black'
  AND T1."XCL_018" LIKE '%extendedart%'
